title: Backtester
intro: Test a rule on the candles Atlas has stored. It runs on history only and can’t place an order.

s.test: Test it in {{n}} walk-forward splits with {{bps}} slippage.

f.name: Name
f.bars: About {{n}} bars per instrument. The limit is {{max}}.
f.barsOver: About {{n}} bars per instrument, over the limit of {{max}}. Use a larger bar or a shorter period.
f.entry: Enter when all of these hold
f.exit: Exit when any of these happen
f.splitsSub: Each split is fitted on the blocks before it and tested on the next one.
f.slipSub: Added to every fill, in basis points

runNote: Usually under a minute. Stored candles only; it can’t reach OKX.

err.period: The start must come before the end.
err.periodMissing: Choose a start and an end date.
err.indClose: “close” is the close price; give the indicator another name.
err.indName: Use letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter.
err.indDup: Another indicator already has this name.
err.window: The window is a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
err.entryNone: Add at least one entry condition.
err.stop: The stop is a percentage above 0 and below 100.
err.tp: The take-profit is a percentage above 0.

e.too_many_bars: The period is too long for this bar size
e.insufficient_data: Too few bars for the splits
e.timeout: The run took longer than 60 seconds
e.trading_core_error: The backtest service refused the run
e.job_failed: The run stopped before it finished

fix.invalid: Fix the field marked below, then run it again.
fix.too_many_bars: Use a larger bar or a shorter period.
fix.no_data: Check Settings → Data for these instruments’ history.
fix.insufficient_data: Use fewer splits, a longer period or a smaller bar.
fix.timeout: Test fewer instruments or a shorter period.
fix.trading_core_error: Check the reason above, then run it again.
fix.trading_core_unavailable: Start Atlas with ./atlas up, then run it again.
fix.job_failed: Run it again. If it keeps stopping, check the backtests queue in Horizon.

e.throttled: Too many runs started in a minute
e.throttledFix: Wait a minute, then run it again.
e.serverFix: Check that Atlas is running, then try again.

runningSub: Atlas checks every 2 seconds. You can leave this page; the run keeps going.
notFoundBody: It may belong to the other environment. Start a new backtest instead.
